replacement_text: Nirvana Insurance is an AI-native commercial trucking insurer that reached a $1.5 billion post-money valuation in its $100 million Series D round (December 2025, led by Valor Equity Partners), bringing total funding to over $260 million. Tokio Marine Future Fund — the $42 million CVC arm of Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co., Ltd., managed by WiL, LLC — is a confirmed portfolio investor, having backed Nirvana at the Series A stage (February 2022), and continues to list Nirvana as an active portfolio company on its fund website as of 2026.
notes: Both sub-claims are now confirmed at High confidence. (1) The $1.5B valuation is confirmed via Nirvana's own PRNewswire Series D press release (Dec 2025) — not merely Crunchbase secondary. (2) Tokio Marine Future Fund's investment is confirmed via the fund's own live portfolio page (tmfuturefund.com) AND verbatim TechCrunch coverage of the April 2022 fund-launch press release. Key pitch-deck nuance: TMFF invested at Series A (~$22M raise) with a check size likely $500K–$3M; the $1.5B Series D was led by Valor Equity Partners, Lightspeed, and General Catalyst — NOT Tokio Marine. The original draft text ('Tokio Marine Future Fund is an investor') is correct but should clarify it is an early-stage investor, not a current-round lead, to avoid misleading the ID&E venture pitch audience. No SEC Form D was found for any Nirvana entity across comprehensive EDGAR searches — the company appears to have not filed Form D for its rounds, which is unusual but not disqualifying.
